title: feat: complete local model library
body:
## P3 — Full local Model Library

Stacked on PR #18 (`completion/verification-packs`), with PR #17 remaining the draft P1 checkpoint.

- adds unified Ollama, LM Studio, and llama.cpp/GGUF discovery with bounded metadata and loopback-only endpoints
- adds managed GGUF import, persisted download/import/removal operations, progress/cancellation, and SHA-256 removal evidence
- adds duplicate grouping with quantization-distinct competitors and explicit source availability
- adds usable desktop catalog/search/source configuration, operation progress/cancel, managed import/removal, hardware recommendation display, and browser-preview honesty
- validates with 90 Rust tests, 63 TypeScript tests, typecheck, Vite build, boundary fixtures, fmt/check, and diff checks

P3 remains IN PROGRESS pending native Tauri/WebView QA, local runtime interaction smoke, and remote CI.

No merge, tag, release, deploy, or public release is included.
